name: Algebraic Subgraph-Edge-Count Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit requirement for a triangle (three edges among three vertices) with a mathematically equivalent algebraic condition on the degrees and cut-edges of the vertex subset ($T = E + 6$). Models that recognize the equivalence will solve it; models that literally translate the condition will write an $O(N^3 M)$ or $O(N^3)$ simulation and TLE.
